capabilities.description: Generate progress claims by measuring executed work against BOQ items (document:harbourline_boq.xlsx), apply 5% retention per Clause 14.3 of document:harbourline_contract.pdf, and produce interim payment certificates with audit trails.

Track days of delay against the 730-day Time for Completion (Clause 8.2) and compute delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day, capped at 10% (Clause 8.7), with alerts and audit evidence from document:harbourline_contract.pdf.
Create, route, and store Inspection and Test Plan (ITP) records linked to BOQ work items in document:harbourline_boq.xlsx, with approval workflows, evidence capture, and quality sign-off tracking.

Maintain a governed register of contract and project documents (including document:harbourline_contract.pdf and document:harbourline_boq.xlsx) with version control, provenance, hashing, search, and access control.

Answer questions and extract obligations from the contract excerpt (document:harbourline_contract.pdf) — such as Time for Completion, Delay Damages, Defects Notification Period, Retention, and Performance Security — grounded in the source text with citations.
Support quantity measurement against BOQ items (document:harbourline_boq.xlsx), track variances between claimed and certified quantities, and record authorised variations with an audit trail.

summary: A contracts-administration platform for the Harbourline Civil Works project that uses the uploaded contract excerpt (document:harbourline_contract.pdf) and BOQ (document:harbourline_boq.xlsx) as the source of record. It serves the project's commercial and quality teams by managing progress claims and payment certification, tracking delay damages against the contractual caps, maintaining QA/ITP inspection records, and providing a governed document register for contract and project documents.
